publications.title: Cellular Sidelink Enabled Decentralized Pedestrian Sensing
publications.research_problem: Cooperative-perception V2X technology focuses on road safety, leaving pedestrian-centric urban sensing unaddressed.

publications.key_contribution: A crowd-sensing approach that needs no central infrastructure, aimed at uses such as pedestrian density maps.
publications.edge_relevance: Mobile Crowdsensing and Crowdsourcing (Computer Science Applications)

publications.title: FUSIONIZE++: Improving Serverless Application Performance Using Dynamic Task Inlining and Infrastructure Optimization
publications.research_problem: Splitting applications into FaaS functions trades flexibility against invocation overhead, extra cold starts and double billing.
publications.approach: Fusionize automatically fuses fine-grained function code into an optimised multi-function composition, adapting task inlining and infrastructure configuration at runtime.
publications.key_contribution: Automated serverless deployment optimisation, so developers can write fine-grained code without hand-tuning the fusion trade-off.
publications.edge_relevance: Cloud Computing and Resource Management (Information Systems)

publications.title: Energy-Aware Duty Cycle Management for Solar-Powered IoT Devices

publications.key_contribution: A case study showing proactive sleep-time adaptation that keeps an IoT application running through forecast cloudy days.
publications.edge_relevance: Green IT and Sustainability (Electrical and Electronic Engineering)

publications.title: The unresolved need for dependable guarantees on security, sovereignty, and trust in data ecosystems
publications.research_problem: Data ecosystems exchange sensitive data between stakeholders, yet current designs rely on organisational trust measures that participants may be incentivised to bypass.

publications.key_contribution: Argues that dependable technical guarantees, not organisational measures alone, are needed and remain an open problem.

publications.title: Edge Generation Scheduling for DAG Tasks Using Deep Reinforcement Learning
publications.research_problem: Scheduling real-time DAG tasks from automotive, avionics and industrial systems under deadlines is hard for existing heuristics.
publications.approach: A schedulability test based on trivial schedulability, and an edge-generation scheduling framework whose policy is learned with deep reinforcement learning and a graph neural network.
publications.key_contribution: Edge Generation Scheduling (EGS), which reduces DAG width while meeting deadlines, compared against state-of-the-art heuristics and an optimal MILP baseline.
